description: Traffic Counts Data is a dataset listed in State of New Jersey open data portal (data.nj.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New Jersey. Traffic counts data for NJ DOT. The data sets includes short term counts (48 hours volumes) and continuous data. Coverage: New Jersey. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are volumes, traffic counts. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: NJ Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2024-03-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-nj-gov-portal.
